versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "interview-drill," enabling interactive, adaptive interview practice based on user-supplied resume, job description, or project materials.
- Asks one interview-style question per turn, then provides concise, evidence-based feedback before continuing.
- Integrates workspace and user-provided source material to verify answers and prevent unsupported claims.
- Dynamically adapts question topics and difficulty based on previous answers and user requests.
- Clearly distinguishes proven implementation details from intended design or future plans in both answers and feedback.
- Honors user requests to pause, change topics, or shift tasks immediately.
